TOWERS HAS A MOBILE FIGMA FRAME. Verified by ARTWORK, not title, at 10130:14171 - a 375x1605 page frame filed "Skai > Play > Casino > Blackjack (375 x 812px)" whose own text reads H1 "Towers", hero card "Towers / Skai Originals", tabs "ARCADE / CASINO", body copy "Climb the tower one row at a time and hope you pick right", plus a Difficulty:Easy bet panel. Two MORE mobile panels sit beside it: 10130:14802 (347x777, the Auto-Advanced panel with On Win / On Loss / Stop on Win / Stop on Loss) and 10130:14946 (347x621, Auto). So the mobile tier is designed, in triplicate, and "design-blocked / can never reach done" is wrong. THE WHOLE SECTION WAS REDRAWN AFTER THE HARVEST - this is the largest drift of the 21 by an order of magnitude: 30 live children on 9061:15449 vs 67 in towers.nodes.txt, with 17 live-only AND 54 catalog-only. The 54 are the old loose-Rectangle scaffolding (Rectangle 34624620-34624680 etc.); they were duplicated onto a separate page the file itself labels "Towars Draft (Disregard)" (10120:10113, 51 children, same layer names, new ids) and cleared off the real page. The 17 live-only are finished design: eight 954x621 desktop board states (10120:10815 Medium, 10120:10859 Hard, 10120:13193 Expert, 10120:13227 Master, 10120:11748 Selection mid game, 10120:13280 Easy Loss reveal, 10130:13627 Easy cashout, 10130:13859 Easy auto Selection), two desktop panels (10130:13720, 10130:14013), the three mobile frames above, and cover art 10130:15152. ANY PARITY MEASUREMENT TAKEN FROM towers.nodes.txt IS MEASURING A DELETED PAGE. `partial`, not `unknown`: route, page shell, widget and the four-action POINTS rail are all present (prod site_config also carries gaming_tower_max_bet=1000), but TowersPage.tsx has no Sections companion - its own header says so verbatim ("Towers still has no `TowersPageSections.tsx`, so that half of the frame is UNBUILT") - so the 1440 page 9079:2001 and the now-proven 375 page 10130:14171 are both unbuilt.
